Alex: Heads up — perf/regression flagged on int4+fp8 mix for model rwd-gpt-xl in prod canary. Eval shows structured JSON output breakage (~4% of eval prompts). Anyone on?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy triggered 2026-03-17T09:12 for rwd-gpt-xl:quant-mix-v3 (canary=10%)

Maria: Saw the eval delta this morning: BLEU -1.8, struct-parse fails on ~4% (mainly nested arrays). Quick glance at logs shows KV mismatches around decode step ~40. Dumping a short trace below:

Maria: ```
[2026-03-17T09:18:03] decode step=39 kv_idx=1024 expected_key_hash=0x8a3f got=0x9b1c
[2026-03-17T09:18:03] fallback to int4 kernel=false path=fp8_selected
[2026-03-17T09:18:03] json-parse-error at token 41
```

Jin: Running a local repro with same seed. I can reproduce on devbox when seq_len > 2048. It looks like the kernel selection heuristic picks fp8 for some layers and int4 for others, and when we mix we sometimes get KV alignment shifts. Suspect the per-layer quant scale mismatch after calibration.

Ben: Perf numbers: int4 path gives ~1.9x throughput on median, but 99p latency spikes ~2.4x. Profiling shows repeated small GPU<->CPU memcpy around KV refresh points (every ~32 tokens). Memory churn might be exposing ordering/timing nondeterminism.

Priya: Hypothesis: KV cache staleness + mixed-kernel calibration differences -> incorrect KV alignment on decode which shifts token boundaries and breaks structured outputs. Also possible that calibration used a different prefix distribution than the live traffic.

Alex: Agree on hypotheses. We should bisect and also compare calibration artifacts. Plan: (1) git-bisect between last-green and this canary, (2) rerun calibration with same dataset/seed, (3) add runtime guard to detect KV offset mismatches and fallback.

Alex: Example commands I'm running locally:

Alex: ```bash
git checkout HEAD~20
git bisect start --bad HEAD --good <last-green-sha>
# run quick eval harness
./infra/eval/run_eval.sh --model rwd-gpt-xl --quant mix --seed 42 --quick
```

Maria: I re-ran the calibration tool with the exact evalset and `--seed 42`. Layers 9-12 produced scale deltas > 6% vs the previous release. Pasting diff snippet in the issue.

Jin: I'll add a quick guard: if any layer's scale delta > 5% then force homogeneous kernel selection (fp8-only) for that model-version on canary. Also will add a KV shape/assert check after kernel selection: if kv_offsets != expected_offsets -> log + fallback. Plan to open small PR with tests.

Ben: Also proposing a lightweight runtime assert: after first decode step verify `kv_base_ptr % 64 == expected_align` and `kv_offsets == nshards * per_shard_stride`. If assert fails, trigger safe fallback path (fp8) and emit perf/error metrics. That should avoid user-facing JSON breaks while we triage.

Priya: I'll queue a longctx (8k) eval run on staging to catch sequence-length-dependent failures. Also will run the structured-output regression suite across seeds [42, 101, 7].

Alex: Action items: Jin -> patch for guard + KV-shape assert + unit tests; Maria -> attach calibration diffs and confirm dataset seed parity; Ben -> perf/mem profiling with the patch; Priya -> longctx eval runs. Target to get hotfix canary by EOD today. :eyes:
